rules.description: Share of signal moves at least 2.0 pts (Google search) or 3.0 pts (Wikipedia), week on week
Average Play Store rating moves at least 0.03 stars, week on week
New Play Store ratings per day change by at least 50%, week on week
Article-weighted news tone changes sign, swinging at least 1.0, with at least 5 articles in each week
Share of recent Play Store reviews that are 1-2 star complaints about a theme moves at least 3.0 pts, week on week

insights.text: News tone on Blinkit turned negative week on week: +1.29 to -0.49 (GDELT, article-weighted).
Blinkit's Wikipedia pageview share rose 3.7 pts week on week, from 62.5% to 66.3%.
Flipkart Minutes's Google search share fell 2.1 pts week on week, from 6.3% to 4.2%.
